dedupe_keys.name: caracteristicas de los sistemas publicos de saneamiento en alta y estaciones depuradoras de agua residual de cataluna

description: Características de los sistemas públicos de saneamiento en alta y estaciones depuradoras de agua residual de Cataluña is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Generalitat de Catalunya. Dades dels sistemes públics de sanejament en alta de Catalunya amb estació depuradora d'aigües residuals (EDAR) finançats per l'Agència Catalana de l'Aigua. Un sistema públic de sanejament en alta és el conjunt d'infraestructures que recullen les aigües residuals de les xarxes de clavegueram municipals, les transporten i les depuren abans del seu retorn al medi. Coverage: Generalitat de Catalunya. The portal shows the English title as "Main features of public sewer system mains and wastewater treatment plants in Catalonia" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Generalitat de Catalunya. Its keywords include habitant equivalent, aigua, ods6_aigua neta i sanejament, bombaments, edar, cabal disseny. The listing shows 3 download or service links in XML, JSON, CSV. The listing shows 2026-09-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://administraciodigital.gencat.cat/ca/dades/dades-obertes/informacio-practica/llicencies/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
